"""Command line: python -m todo.cli [--file PATH] {add TEXT, list, done N}."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse

from todo.items import Item, format_line
from todo.store import load, save


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    """Run one command on the todo file and return the exit code."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="todo")
    parser.add_argument("--file", default="todo.txt", help="todo file (default: todo.txt)")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("add", help="add an item").add_argument("text")
    sub.add_parser("list", help="show every item with its number")
    sub.add_parser("done", help="mark a item as done").add_argument("number", type=int)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    items = load(args.file)
    if args.command == "add":
        items.append(Item(args.text))
        save(args.file, items)
    elif args.command == "list":
        for number, item in enumerate(items, start=1):
            print(f"{number}. {format_line(item)}")
    elif args.command == "done":
        items[args.number - 1].done = True
        save(args.file, items)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from todo.cli import main
from todo.items import Item, format_line, parse_line
from todo.store import load, save


def test_parse_open_item():
    assert parse_line("[ ] buy milk") == Item("buy milk")


def test_parse_done_item():
    assert parse_line("[x] pay rent") == Item("pay rent", done=True)


def test_format_line():
    assert format_line(Item("call bob", done=True)) == "[x] call bob"


def test_save_and_load(tmp_path):
    path = str(tmp_path / "todo.txt")
    items = [Item("a"), Item("b", done=True)]
    save(path, items)
    assert load(path) == items


def test_done_marks_the_numbered_item(tmp_path):
    path = str(tmp_path / "todo.txt")
    main(["--file", path, "add", "first"])
    main(["--file", path, "add", "second"])
    main(["--file", path, "done", "1"])
    assert [item.done for item in load(path)] == [True, False]

"""Load and save the todo file, one item per line."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from todo.items import Item, format_line, parse_line


def load(path: str) -> list[Item]:
    """The items in the todo file at path; a missing file has no items."""
    todo_file = Path(path)
    if not todo_file.exists():
        return []
    return [parse_line(line) for line in todo_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]


def save(path: str, items: list[Item]) -> None:
    """Write items to the todo file at path, replacing what was there."""
    text = "".join(format_line(item) + "\n" for item in items)
    Path(path).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
